column1: # The Esperanto word that comes first when searching a word of another language, where the order by
# frequency (Frequency.kt) puts a worse one first, mostly very common grammatical words ("aus": de
# before el). Only words that Reta Vortaro already gives for that word: this changes their order,
# nothing else; a word that is rare, archaic, to avoid or advised against by Vortoj de la bona lingvo
# stays last all the same. Language, word as searched, Esperanto word.
